integrity: The proof is self-contained; a standalone deterministic finite verifier checks the local rigidity mechanism and exact wall moments. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Fixed cyclic bandwidth two and iid edge retention only; limits are asymptotic, point-process and conditional size laws, not finite-size identities; threshold location already known from Federico (2024). A complete earlier equivalent result may exist.
title: Poisson walls and Dirichlet component spacings at the critical window of percolated cycle squares
